tasks.label: Verify user cleanup
args: const { loadEnvConfig } = require('@next/env'); loadEnvConfig(process.cwd()); const { MongoClient } = require('mongodb'); (async()=>{ const client=new MongoClient(process.env.MONGODB_URI); await client.connect(); const db=client.db(); const users=db.collection('users'); const ordinaryUsers=await users.countDocuments({role:'user'}); const adminAccounts=(await users.countDocuments({role:'admin'}))+(await users.countDocuments({role:'superadmin'})); console.log(JSON.stringify({ordinaryUsers,adminAccounts})); await client.close(); })().catch(error=>{console.error(error.message); process.exit(1);});
